# First, filter the dataframe for the years 1995 to 2009 inclusive
df_filtered = df[(df['year'] >= 1995) & (df['year'] <= 2009)]

# Count the number of prizes for each beer in this period
prize_counts = df_filtered['beer name'].value_counts()

# Determine the beer with the maximum number of prizes
max_prizes = prize_counts.max()
most_decorated_beers = prize_counts[prize_counts == max_prizes].index.tolist()

# Check if 'maggs magnificent mild' is among the most decorated beers
answer = 'maggs magnificent mild' in most_decorated_beers
